one_liner: Camera-based light meter for houseplants: measure light at home spots, map spots, match plants to the right spot
target_user: houseplant owners whose plants keep dying from wrong light placement
core_job: measure light via camera at a spot, log spot profiles, match plant light needs to spots
primary_interaction: scan spot with camera -> get light band -> compare with plant needs -> place and track
wedge_hypothesis: plant apps are ID/watering logs; hardware lux meters cost money; phone light mapping for placement is underserved
